card.title: There Is a Process
card.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.

mechanism: A treats reassurance and then a hug as applications needing defined scope and terms.
confusable: Unlike merely asking what comfort B needs, A must convert the emotional need into approval categories and documentation.
comparison: Wedding anxiety becomes renewable reassurance terms; the umbrella scene processes a soaked borrower's urgency.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
